svg.text: ← Grouped by company (SpaceX, Arianespace, ULA, Rocket Lab, Chinese startups)
Grouped by nation / agency (USSR, United States, Russia, China, India, Japan, ESA) →
USSR opens Space Age with first artificial satellite
Vostok 1 orbits Earth carrying Yuri Gagarin
NASA Saturn V lands first humans on lunar surface
USSR achieves 106 successful launches in 1 year
Russian Federation assumes program; launch rates fall
China becomes 3rd nation with crewed spaceflight
NASA Artemis & CNSA Chang'e/Tiangong lunar focus;
LEO satellite launches left to commercial sector
Arianespace founded as world's first commercial launch firm
International Launch Services (ILS) markets Proton commercially
First privately-developed liquid-fuel rocket to reach orbit
Falcon 9 first stage lands vertically, proving orbital reusability
SpaceX Crew Dragon carries NASA astronauts to the ISS;
Starlink mass deployment accelerates in low-Earth orbit
SpaceX exceeds 130 orbital missions/year; Rocket Lab expands in US & NZ;
Chinese commercial entrants (Galactic Energy, LandSpace, CAS Space) ramp up;
Commercial operators account for 77.2% of all global
1 rectangular unit tile = 1 successful orbital launch
Source: Jonathan McDowell, General Catalog of Artificial Space Objects (GCAT, planet4589.org); data includes successful orbital launches through September 6, 2026.
*2026 data reflects year-to-date launches through September 6, 2026.
